headline_finding: The denominator cannot be built from currently admitted sources, so coverage is not evaluable under v1.

source_feasibility.reason: The admitted official archives do not establish complete opening membership, every effective start and end including contract expiration, assignment and recall, suspension, or same-day ordering for all four seasons.
source_feasibility.new_source_acquisition_scope: Not attempted: acquiring a new source is separate Adapter-gate work and may require an owner-only paid-data decision.

evidence.finding: The admitted archives emit transaction evidence only, omit required event classes and effective instants, and cannot establish a complete player-game denominator.

evidence.line_range_stability: Pointer only; the sha256 above is the load-bearing check. The previous justification here - that the range precedes an append-only file's append point - was disproven on 2026-09-06, when an in-place amendment to an item earlier in docs/backlog.md moved this range by +115 lines while leaving its bytes identical. docs/backlog.md is not append-only in practice: items are amended and status markers flipped in place. Any edit above this range invalidates these line numbers, and the digest is what detects it.
evidence.finding: The backlog records that no complete independent denominator or unknown share can be calculated from the admitted evidence.
Classification is forbidden until the source registry, reconstruction contract, roster manifest, and schedule manifest are frozen and independently reproduced.

unknown_diagnostics.reason: Without a canonical cohort there are no player-game keys to classify, so genuine source absence cannot be separated from unresolved roster or identity joins.

specification_gap.finding: Section 4 requires integer counts and exact division, while section 5 permits a prerequisite evidence failure in which no denominator exists. V1 cannot represent that failure inside its canonical predicate shape.
specification_gap.required_v2_change: Define a machine-readable non-evaluable state before integer count validation and division, while preserving zero-denominator refusal.

next_source_acceptance_criteria: complete opening NBA roster membership for every team and season
effective start and exclusive end instants for every roster interval
explicit contract expiration and release boundaries
assignment and recall boundaries based on effective reporting instants
deterministic same-day event and game ordering
could_not_verify: Whether a free authoritative source not currently admitted by the repository can satisfy the complete four-season interval contract.
Whether a paid source can satisfy the contract; evaluating or adopting one is an owner-only decision.
The 2022-23 season boundary against the blocked official NBA press release.
Any overall or per-season opportunity, class, unknown, duplicate, unclassified, or provenance count.
